parts.name: Lower plate
parts.tip: Flat plate under everything, 9 mm thick so its top is level with the face of the AUX LTS panel behind it. The outline is The Warthog Project's Seat Panel Lower with the aft edge trimmed. The four mounting screws sit in 12 mm pockets, 6 mm deep. In the jet this deck is tilted about 15 deg nose-up and 13 deg toward the pilot; the model is drawn relative to it.

parts.name: Seat control box
parts.tip: A rectangular box with its aft inboard corner cut at 45 deg for the seat panel. Angles are worked out from reference views: aft wall 65 deg from the deck, seat face 63 deg from the deck and turned 48 deg toward the right side, top tilted 28 deg to the deck. Width, depth and height are estimated. The back and the outboard end don't show in any reference I have, so those are my own shapes: back square to the deck, outboard end leaning 20 deg inboard.

parts.name: EMER BRAKE handle
parts.tip: One L-shaped part, square to the plate side to side. After the fit mockup it is 12 mm taller than the references suggest, the grip stands 65 deg from the foot (59 in the jet), and the foot is 32 mm from heel to block. Grip 88 long, 8 thick. Each side is one flat plane, 14.5 wide at the foot's underside tapering to 10.5 at the top, so it prints lying on its side. The shaft runs 8 deg to the deck (my choice; the jet's is 25).
